en.headline: sogeisetsu 2026-10-20: 6 own commits, 22 automated, release 0.1.0
en.summary: All activity landed in two repositories. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` the user made 5 commits covering the git spec runtime-loading tests, the 0.1.0 release lifecycle acceptance (update/remove and host CLI edge cases), v5 real-host round-trip regression evidence (disable → permission.rejected → enable → byte-for-byte restore), and a chore commit that released `0.1.0` through trusted publishing with provenance. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` one commit fixed the summary rule so automated commits must be phrased additively, never with an "of which"/"包含" containment style. On top of the **6 own commits** there were 22 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. No pull requests, issues, reviews, releases, stars, replies, or discussions were recorded, and no section hit its collection cap.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 2026-10-20：6 次本人提交与 22 次自动提交，发布 0.1.0
zh.summary: 当天活动集中在两个仓库。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 中，用户提交了 5 次，内容涉及 git spec 运行时加载实测、0.1.0 发布生命周期验收（update/remove 与宿主 CLI 小坑）、v5 真实宿主往返回归证据（disable → permission.rejected → enable → 逐字节还原），以及一次通过 trusted publishing 发布 `0.1.0` 并带 provenance 的 chore 提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中有 1 次提交，修正了摘要规则，要求自动提交必须写成相加表述，禁止「其中/包含」式写法。除 **6 次本人提交** 外，`github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中另有 22 次自动提交。当天没有 pull request、issue、review、release、star、回复或讨论记录，且各部分均未触发收集上限。
